ServiceInterface.description: The AlignBOM service interface exposes the operations that enable the alignment of Design BOM and Engineering BOM.
ServiceInterface.name: AlignBOM

MetaEnum.description: This enum value will decide which type of alignment will be performed between the design and Part, i.e occurrence alignment or part-cad alignment.
MetaEnum.name: AlignmentType

Struct.description: The service response structure containing the alignment report information.
Struct.name: PerformDbomEbomAlignmentResponse

StructElement.description: Dataset which contains the report details for DBOM-EBOM Alignment operation.
StructElement.name: dataset

Typedef.description: A string to string map of user options and their respective values.
Typedef.name: StringToStringMap

OperationTemplate.description: This operation performs alignment between the Design BOM and Engineering BOM in context of given BOMLine objects of designContextLine and partContextLine based on the property matching mentioned in the preference Pma0_Align_DBOM_EBOM_Criteria. This could be Part-Cad alignment or Occurrence alignment depending on the selected alignment type.
OperationTemplate.name: Pma0::Soa::BOMAutomation::AlignBOM::performDbomEbomAlignment
OperationTemplate.returnDescription:
The following partial errors may be returned as part of service data:
- 1707 Preference value not been defined correctly.
- 427011 The given context is not a valid Part or Design type.
- 427030 Property value type is not supported.

OperationParameter.description: A list of design BOMLine objects in context of which alignment will be performed.
OperationParameter.name: designContextLines

OperationParameter.description: A list of part BOMLine objects in context of which alignment will be performed.
OperationParameter.name: partContextLines

OperationParameter.description: The type of alignment to be performed between the design and part - "OccurrenceAlignment" or "PartCadAlignment".
OperationParameter.name: alignmentType

OperationParameter.description: Specifies whether the alignment operation report to be generated. If true, alignment report will be generated, and it will be attached to a Dataset object that will be returned in the SOA response; otherwise, report won't be generated.
OperationParameter.name: generateReport

OperationParameter.description: Specifies whether the operation should be executed in the background as an asynchronous operation. If true, operation will be executed in background as an asynchronous operation; otherwise, it will be executed in foreground.
OperationParameter.name: runInBackground

OperationParameter.description:
A map (string, string) containing pairs of user options and their respective values.
This is optional input, and it can be empty.
The entries may include if alignment automation to be performed in single context or entire product.
e.g option = "alignmentDepth", value="1", this means that the alignment will be performed only for 1st level children of given contexts.
OperationParameter.name: userOptions

OperationTemplate.description: This operation performs alignment between the Design BOM and Engineering BOM in context of given BOMLine objects of designContextLine and partContextLine based on the property matching mentioned in the preference Pma0_Align_DBOM_EBOM_Criteria. This could be Part-Cad alignment or Occurrence alignment depending on the selected alignment type.
OperationTemplate.name: Pma0::Soa::BOMAutomation::AlignBOM::performDbomEbomAlignmentAsync
OperationTemplate.returnDescription:
Void. As this operation is asynchronous, it does not return any data. In the event of success, the user will receive notification through a success message in the alerts section. If the operation fails due to some partial errors, the user will be notified through a message in the alerts section.
e.g If one of the given contexts is not a valid Part or Design type, then the operation would fail for it but for other valid contexts the operation will be executed. In this case we will return the error for the failed contexts.

OperationParameter.description: A list of design BOMLine objects in context of which alignment will be performed.
OperationParameter.name: designContextLines

OperationParameter.description: A list of part BOMLine objects in context of which alignment will be performed.
OperationParameter.name: partContextLines

OperationParameter.description: The type of alignment to be performed between the design and part - "OccurrenceAlignment" or "PartCadAlignment".
OperationParameter.name: alignmentType

OperationParameter.description: Specifies whether the alignment operation report to be generated. If true, alignment report will be generated, and it will be attached to a Dataset object that will be returned in the SOA response; otherwise, report won't be generated.
OperationParameter.name: generateReport

OperationParameter.description:
A map (string, string) containing pairs of user options and their respective values.
This is optional input, and it can be empty.

Operation.description: This operation performs alignment between the Design BOM and Engineering BOM in context of given BOMLine objects of designContextLine and partContextLine based on the property matching mentioned in the preference Pma0_Align_DBOM_EBOM_Criteria. This could be Part-Cad alignment or Occurrence alignment depending on the selected alignment type.
Operation.name: performDbomEbomAlignment
Operation.returnDescription:
The following partial errors may be returned as part of service data:
- 1707 Preference value not been defined correctly.
- 427011 The given context is not a valid Part or Design type.
- 427030 Property value type is not supported.
Operation.useCase:
User passes a list of design context lines and part context lines, with either Part-Cad alignment or Occurrence alignment as alignment type. This operation will perform the alignment between the engineering BOM lines and the design BOM lines which are children of the given context lines.

This alignment will be based on the property matching defined in the preference Pma0_Align_DBOM_EBOM_Criteria.

ParameterInfo.description: A list of design BOMLine objects in context of which alignment will be performed.
A list of part BOMLine objects in context of which alignment will be performed.
The type of alignment to be performed between the design and part - "OccurrenceAlignment" or "PartCadAlignment".

Specifies whether the alignment operation report to be generated. If true, alignment report will be generated, and it will be attached to a Dataset object that will be returned in the SOA response; otherwise, report won't be generated.

Specifies whether the operation should be executed in the background as an asynchronous operation. If true, operation will be executed in background as an asynchronous operation; otherwise, it will be executed in foreground.

Operation.name: performDbomEbomAlignmentAsync
Operation.returnDescription:
Void. As this operation is asynchronous, it does not return any data. In the event of success, the user will receive notification through a success message in the alerts section. If the operation fails due to some partial errors, the user will be notified through a message in the alerts section.
e.g If one of the given contexts is not a valid Part or Design type, then the operation would fail for it but for other valid contexts the operation will be executed. In this case we will return the error for the failed contexts.
